tasks.title: Dependable input
tasks.note: One ordered input path. Paste up to 1 MiB in adaptive chunks, link drops, visible input state.

tasks.title: Activity as a live pane
tasks.note: Sibling pane, newest first, bound to the selected PTY, memory only.

tasks.title: Voice in DOT sessions
tasks.note: The app declares microphone use so dictation in a session can ask macOS. Needs the installed app rebuilt.

tasks.title: Plan in the sidebar
tasks.note: This panel, fed from a tasks file shipped with the UI.

tasks.title: Event stream from the raw log
tasks.note: The PTY byte stream is the raw log. The backend derives typed events from it and from an agent log you opt into.

tasks.title: Collapsed tool cards
tasks.note: A wider Activity view: every tool run collapsed by default, expand on demand. The terminal itself is never folded.

tasks.title: Installed runtime and auto-refresh
tasks.note: A versioned runtime outside any build folder. The UI reloads itself on a new version; sessions survive.

tasks.title: Phone runs the same UI
tasks.note: Thin native shell (device key, pinned TLS, QR pairing) around this same interface. Blocked: phone needs reconnecting.

tasks.title: Geometry and incarnation on reads
tasks.note: Built and tested on a parked branch. Removes the per-chunk screen fetch and the last resize race.

tasks.title: Session catalog, clipboard, file transfer
tasks.note: Across paired devices, explicit and consented.

tasks.title: Mesh, secret broker, worldlines, iPad, Windows
tasks.note: Preserved in HANDOFF.md as requirements and research. None of it is implemented.
